# Stratovac

> Stratovac (part of ID Industry, Quebec, Canada) supplies oil-free regenerative boosters and blowers for high pressure, corrosive gases, explosive atmospheres and non-stop duty, plus standard equipment: electric air boosters, turbo blowers, claw compressors, regenerative blowers and oil-lubricated vacuum pumps for maple producers. Sales in English and French, in Canada and the United States. Contact: abruens@stratovac.ca, +1-438-880-4655.

Quotes are made on request: send the operating point (gas, flow, inlet and outlet pressure, duty, hazardous-area class) or, for maple, the number of taps and the current pump. Prices are not published on the site.

## Standard equipment
- [Electric high-pressure air booster](https://stratovac.ca/electric-air-booster/): A high-speed regenerative booster that doubles the pressure of compressed air or nitrogen on electric power alone. It replaces pneumatic and piston boosters without drawing compressed air or adding oil.
- [Surpresseur d’air électrique haute pression (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/surpresseur-air-electrique/)
- [Vacuum pumps for maple producers](https://stratovac.ca/maple-vacuum-pumps/): Oil-lubricated rotary vane pumps for sugar bushes, 12 to 780 m³/h, with an oil heater that keeps water out of the oil. Maximum vacuum up to 29.9 inHg (0.1 mbar absolute). Replacement parts available for AirTech Vacuum pumps sold by CDL.
- [Pompes à vide pour érablières (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/pompes-a-vide-erabliere/)
- [Oil-free claw compressors](https://stratovac.ca/claw-compressors/): Dry-running, contact-free claw compressors, 68 to 600 m³/h, up to 2.2 bar, for clean low-pressure air.
- [Compresseurs à griffes sans huile (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/compresseurs-a-griffes/)
- [Oil-free claw vacuum pumps](https://stratovac.ca/claw-vacuum-pumps/): Dry-running claw vacuum pumps, 30 to 1,140 m³/h, air- or water-cooled, 50 and 60 Hz.
- [Pompes à vide à griffes sans huile (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/pompes-a-vide-a-griffes/)
- [High-speed turbo blower](https://stratovac.ca/turbo-blower/): A compact, oil-free turbo blower with a patented high-speed motor and a built-in variable frequency drive. Speed is set from the screen or over MODBUS, and the unit needs no routine maintenance.
- [Turbosouffleuse haute vitesse (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/soufflante-turbo/)
- [Standard regenerative blowers](https://stratovac.ca/standard-blowers/): Side-channel blowers for vacuum and pressure, from small single-stage units to three-stage models. Motors come in 50 and 60 Hz, with explosion-proof, CSA and ULc certified options.
- [Soufflantes régénératives standard (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/soufflantes-standard/)
- [High-speed regenerative blower](https://stratovac.ca/high-speed-blower/): A compact, lightweight blower for equipment where space and weight count. The same unit works as a vacuum pump or a compressor over its whole performance curve.
- [Soufflante régénérative haute vitesse (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/soufflante-haute-vitesse/)

## Custom engineered
- [High-pressure natural gas booster](https://stratovac.ca/natural-gas-booster/): A magnetically coupled side-channel booster with a stainless steel casing. Identical units stack in series to reach the discharge pressure the job needs.
- [Surpresseur haute pression pour gaz naturel (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/surpresseur-gaz-naturel/)
- [Biogas regenerative blower](https://stratovac.ca/biogas-blower/): A gearless, oil-free blower built to move wet, corrosive biogas around the clock. No gearbox, no belts and no shaft seals.
- [Soufflante régénérative pour biogaz (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/soufflante-biogaz/)
- [Custom pressurized regenerative blowers](https://stratovac.ca/pressurized-blowers/): For gas circuits that run at line pressure. The whole casing is engineered and tested as a pressure part, and a magnetic drive replaces the shaft seal.
- [Soufflantes régénératives sous pression sur mesure (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/soufflantes-pressurisees/)

## Free tools

- [Unit converter](https://stratovac.ca/unit-converter/): CFM to m³/h, inches of water to inches of mercury, psi, bar, mbar, vacuum level (inHg to mbar absolute), power and temperature.
- [Pressure drop calculator](https://stratovac.ca/pressure-drop-calculator/): pressure loss in air, gas and vacuum piping from flow, pipe diameter, length and fittings.
- [Convertisseur d’unités (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/convertisseur-unites/)
- [Calculateur de perte de charge (français)](https://stratovac.ca/fr/calculateur-perte-de-charge/)
